statements.statement: The service is mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229)
The denial reason code is PR-204
The clinical indication note documents recurrent episodes of palpitations and a sensation of rapid heart rate
The clinical indication note raises clinical suspicion for supraventricular tachycardia
The mobile cardiac telemetry study was ordered for continuous rhythm monitoring to capture the arrhythmia during symptomatic events and guide further management
The diagnosis codes are I47.1 and R00.2
The service is not covered under the member's current benefit plan
